results.test: Core regressions run on the exact requested WordPress WooCommerce PHP and HPOS matrix
Draft date and strategy edits atomically replan selected products without changing Woo prices or snapshots
Failed audit insert rolls back every draft row and its campaign version
Connection loss exactly at COMMIT fails closed and cannot report an unsaved draft as saved
Disconnect before the second item update cannot replay an autocommitted partial draft
Active campaigns and drafts with owned prices reject financial replanning
Schema 2 to 3 migration removes retired settings and preserves snapshot intent retry and prices byte for byte
A failed legacy-settings SELECT cannot falsely advance the migration version marker
Reports include registered custom sales status and count a multi-item order once while excluding nonsale statuses
Real partial line refund reduces campaign revenue and units without removing the remaining sale
A fully cash-refunded order is excluded even if its status is later changed back to processing
Reporting-settings invalidation changes cached statistics without changing pricing version or snapshot
